recipes.name: Prawn cocktail in lettuce cups
recipes.method_note: Make the sauce up to a day ahead. Assemble just before serving so the lettuce stays crisp.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:mayonnaise}} and {{ing:tomato-ketchup}} with a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}.
Stir in {{ing:prawns-cooked}} until coated.
Separate {{ing:lettuce-iceberg}} into 8 cup-shaped leaves.
Dice {{ing:cucumber}} finely. Put a little in each leaf.
Spoon the prawns on top. Dust with {{ing:paprika}}.
Serve with the rest of the lemon in wedges.

swaps.text: Cubes of firm tofu or extra vegetables, for a vegetarian version

recipes.name: Garlic mushrooms on toast
recipes.method_note: Let the mushrooms brown before you stir. Stirring too soon makes them watery.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a large frying pan on a high heat.
Add the mushrooms in one layer. Leave 3 minutes, until browned underneath.
Stir. Cook 3 minutes more, until golden all over.
Add the garlic. Stir 1 minute.
Toast {{ing:bread-slice-medium}}.
Squeeze in {{ing:lemon}}. Stir in the parsley. Spoon onto the toast.

swaps.text: A dairy-free block or spread, or olive oil where it is only for frying, to make it dairy free

recipes.name: Whipped feta with honey and warm pitta
recipes.method_note: Blend it longer than you think. It goes from grainy to silky.

steps.instruction: Blend {{ing:feta}} and {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} for 2 minutes, until smooth.
Spread in a shallow bowl with the back of a spoon.
Drizzle over {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:honey}}. Sprinkle with {{ing:dried-oregano}}.
Warm {{ing:pitta-bread}} in a toaster. Cut into strips for dipping.

swaps.text: Maple syrup, to make it vegan
Coconut or soya yoghurt, to make it dairy free

recipes.name: Crispy halloumi with chilli honey
recipes.method_note: Serve straight from the pan. Halloumi turns rubbery as it cools.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:halloumi}} into thick fingers. Toss in {{ing:cornflour}}.
Slice {{ing:chilli-fresh}} thinly. Warm it with {{ing:honey}} in a small pan, 1 minute.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a frying pan on a medium-high heat.
Fry the halloumi 2 minutes each side, until golden and crisp.
Drizzle with the chilli honey. Squeeze over {{ing:lime}}.

swaps.text: Maple syrup, to make it vegan

recipes.name: Smoked salmon and cucumber bites
recipes.method_note: Can be made an hour ahead and kept covered in the fridge.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:cream-cheese}} with the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Spread over {{ing:wholemeal-bread-slice}}. Cut off the crusts.
Cut each slice into four squares.
Slice {{ing:cucumber}} thinly. Lay a slice on each square.
Top with folds of {{ing:smoked-salmon}}. Finish with {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}.

recipes.name: Beetroot, orange and walnut salad
recipes.method_note: Ready-cooked beetroot works perfectly. Avoid the kind in vinegar.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:beetroot}} into wedges.
steps.note: Raw beetroot? Boil it whole for 40 minutes, until tender, then cool and peel.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:orange}}. Slice into rounds.
Toast {{ing:walnuts}} in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until fragrant.
Spread {{ing:spinach}} on a plate. Arrange beetroot and orange on top.
Whisk {{ing:olive-oil}} with {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}. Drizzle over.
Scatter the walnuts.

swaps.text: Toasted seeds, for a nut-free version
Kale or chard; give them 2 minutes longer

recipes.name: Garlic and herb stuffed mushrooms
recipes.method_note: One big mushroom each is a starter. Two is a light supper.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Pull the stalks from {{ing:portobello-mushroom}}. Chop the stalks finely.
Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Mix stalks, garlic, parsley and {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}} with 2 tablespoons of the oil.
Add the zest of {{ing:lemon}}. Pile into the mushroom caps.
Drizzle with the rest of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Bake 18 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Pork and ginger lettuce cups
recipes.method_note: Eaten with your hands. Fold the lettuce round the filling like a taco.

steps.instruction: Grate {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Slice {{ing:spring-onion}}.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a frying pan on a high heat.
Fry {{ing:pork-mince}} 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and crisp.
Add ginger and garlic. Stir 1 minute.
Stir in {{ing:soy-sauce}}, the juice of {{ing:lime}} and the spring onion.
Separate {{ing:lettuce-iceberg}} into cups. Spoon the pork in.
Scatter chopped {{ing:peanuts}} over.

swaps.text: Plant-based mince or finely chopped mushrooms, for a vegetarian version
